Brief: Tell me about the Silk Road and elaborate on its influence. — about Routes

1. Two important Silk Road paths from Merv went through Nisa and Sarakhs.
2. They joined together in Masshad, a big religious and trade city in Khurasan.
3. The old road—now a modern highway—went from Masshad to Nishapur, then along the edge of the Dasht-e Kevir desert and the Alborz Mountains, reaching Tehran (called Ray in ancient times).
4. Merchants along these routes were involved in "relay trade" in which goods changed "hands many times before reaching their final destinations".
